Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What is included in Comprehensive Health Check by Thyrocare?
Comprehensive Health Check by Thyrocare includes important tests such as CBC, blood sugar test, thyroid profile, liver function test, kidney function test, cholesterol profile, urine analysis, and other preventive health screening parameters.
2. Why should I take Comprehensive Health Check by Thyrocare?
Thyrocare Comprehensive Health Check helps detect diabetes, thyroid disorders, cholesterol imbalance, liver and kidney problems, anemia, and lifestyle-related health issues at an early stage.
3. Does Comprehensive Health Check include diabetes and thyroid tests?
Yes, Thyrocare Comprehensive Health Check includes blood sugar tests and thyroid profile tests that help monitor diabetes risk and thyroid hormone imbalance.
4. Can I book Comprehensive Health Check online with home collection?
Yes, you can book Thyrocare Comprehensive Health Check online with free home sample collection. It is suitable for users searching for full body checkup near me or preventive health package at home.
5. Who should take Comprehensive Health Check by Thyrocare?
Comprehensive Health Check by Thyrocare is recommended for adults, working professionals, senior citizens, and individuals experiencing fatigue, weakness, stress, obesity, or lifestyle-related health concerns.
6. Is fasting required for Comprehensive Health Check?
Yes, fasting may be required for some tests included in Thyrocare Comprehensive Health Check, especially blood sugar and lipid profile tests. Follow the instructions provided before sample collection.
7. How long does it take to get Comprehensive Health Check reports?
Reports for Thyrocare Comprehensive Health Check are generally available within 24 to 48 hours after sample collection, depending on processing time and location.
8. Why is preventive health screening important?
Preventive health screening by Thyrocare helps identify health issues like diabetes, thyroid imbalance, cholesterol problems, liver disorders, and vitamin deficiencies before symptoms become severe, supporting early treatment and healthier living.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
Q: What is the Thyrocare Senior Citizen Profile – Male?
Ans.
The Senior Citizen Profile – Male is a specially curated health checkup package by Thyrocare designed to evaluate the overall health of elderly men. This comprehensive profile includes 127 tests that assess vital organ functions, detect nutrient deficiencies, and screen for common age-related health concerns such as diabetes, thyroid issues, heart conditions, and cancer markers.
Q: What tests are included in this profile?
Ans.
The package covers a wide range of diagnostic categories, including:
Kidney Function Tests (KFT)
Liver Function Tests (LFT)
Thyroid Profile (TSH, T3, T4)
Diabetic Profile (FBS, HbA1c)
Lipid Profile (Cholesterol, HDL, LDL, Triglycerides)
Electrolyte Panel (Sodium, Potassium, Chloride)
Iron Studies
Vitamin D and B12
Pancreatic and Cardiac Markers
Cancer Screening Markers (PSA, CEA, CA 19.9)
These tests provide a holistic overview of an elderly male’s health status and help in early detection of underlying issues.
Q: Why should senior men take this test?
Ans.
As men age, the risk of chronic diseases and nutrient deficiencies increases. This profile helps detect early signs of hypertension, diabetes, cardiovascular issues, prostate abnormalities, and liver or kidney disorders, enabling proactive management and improving quality of life. Its ideal for annual health screening or if one is experiencing fatigue, weight loss, or other unexplained symptoms.
Q: Is fasting required before the test?
Ans.
Yes, 8–10 hours of fasting is recommended to ensure accurate readings for blood sugar, lipid profile, and other metabolic parameters. Drinking water is permitted during the fasting period.
Q: How is the test performed?
Ans.
A trained technician will visit your home to collect blood and urine samples. BookMyTest provides free home sample collection across India, ensuring a hassle-free experience for elderly individuals.
Q: When will I get the test results?
Ans.
The reports are usually delivered within 24 to 48 hours and are shared via email, WhatsApp, and on your BookMyTest online dashboard.
Q: What is the cost of the Senior Citizen Profile – Male?
Ans.
This package is affordably priced and includes free home collection. For the latest pricing or to book your test, visit www.bookmytest.co.in.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
Q: What is the Thyrocare Senior Citizen Profile – Female?
Ans.
The Senior Citizen Profile – Female is a comprehensive health checkup package specifically designed for elderly women. It includes 127 essential tests to assess the functioning of key organs such as the heart, kidneys, liver, thyroid, and more. The profile also monitors diabetes, lipid levels, electrolytes, and screens for hypertension and cancer markers, helping detect common health risks that increase with age.
Q: What tests are included in this package?
Ans.
This extensive package includes:
Kidney Function Tests (KFT)
Liver Function Tests (LFT)
Thyroid Profile (TSH, T3, T4)
Diabetic Profile (FBS, HbA1c)
Lipid Profile (Total Cholesterol, HDL, LDL, Triglycerides)
Electrolyte Panel (Sodium, Potassium, Chloride)
Vitamin D and B12
Iron Studies
Cardiac Risk Markers
Cancer Markers (CA 125, CEA, CA 15.3)
These tests offer a complete analysis of a woman’s health, especially post-menopause when risks for chronic conditions tend to increase.
Q: Who should consider taking this test?
Ans.
Women aged 50 and above or those experiencing symptoms like fatigue, bone pain, hormonal changes, frequent infections, or unexplained weight loss should consider this test. It is also highly recommended as an annual preventive health checkup to track changes and catch illnesses early.
Q: Is fasting required for this test?
Ans.
Yes, fasting for 8–10 hours is required for accurate results, especially for glucose and lipid profiles. Water can be consumed during this period.
Q: How is the test conducted?
Ans.
A certified technician will visit your home to collect the required blood and urine samples. BookMyTest offers free home sample collection, ensuring convenience and comfort, especially for elderly patients.
Q: When will I receive the reports?
Ans.
Reports are typically available within 24 to 48 hours and are delivered via email, WhatsApp, and your BookMyTest account.
Q: What is the cost of the Senior Citizen Profile – Female?
Ans.
This package is offered at a budget-friendly price and includes free home collection. To check the current pricing or book your test, visit www.bookmytest.co.in.
